title: Privacy Policy
lede: This policy explains what information opetlife collects about you and your pets, why we need it, who can see it, how long we keep it and how you stay in control. We do not sell your data, and we do not use advertising or analytics trackers.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are and what this covers
paragraphs: This policy covers the opetlife website, the installable app and the Android app. The operator, whose details are shown in the site footer and on the Contact page, is responsible for your data. Partners who receive your information to provide a service (for example a clinic you book) are responsible for their own use of it, and must follow this policy and the law.

The Android app shows the same site and asks for only two Android permissions: internet access, and permission to show notifications (Android 13 and later), which it requests only when you turn notifications on. It does not ask for location, camera, contacts or storage. When a feature such as the pet taxi, lost pets or a photo upload needs your location or camera, the browser asks you each time. The app's offline cache keeps only static files such as styles and images, never your pages or data, and the app contains no analytics or third-party SDKs.

sections.heading: 2. What we collect
items: Account: your mobile number and email (with whether you have verified them), username, name, display name and photo, language and theme, and a securely hashed password if you set one. We do not ask for your national ID number.

Household and pets: household members and their roles, and each pet's profile (name, species, breed, sex, date of birth, photo, weight, markings, neutering and microchip). It also includes the health information you add: allergies, conditions, medications, vaccinations, visits, lab results and documents.

Addresses and location: the delivery or visit addresses you save and their map points, which you place and agree to when you save an address. When you allow it, your browser's location is used for nearby services and places (rounded, and only for that search, never stored), lost-pet alerts and the pet taxi.

Bookings, orders and payments: what you booked or bought, delivery details, and refunds and disputes. For card-to-card payments we keep the receipt image you upload. We do not collect your bank card number or IBAN.
What you publish: posts, comments, chats, reviews, lost and found reports, memorials, and the photos and files you upload. Location data inside photos (EXIF and GPS) is removed when you upload them.

Place suggestions: the name, category, city, address, map point and notes of a place you suggest. Only our staff can see that it came from you. If our team checks and lists the place, its details and your notes may be published, never your name. We tell you in the app whether your suggestion was accepted.
Support and messages: your support requests and our replies, and the notifications we send you.

Technical: for each signed-in session, the device's browser details and IP address. For push notifications, your browser's push address. When someone opens a health share link, we log the time, browser details and a scrambled form of the IP address.

sections.heading: 3. Why we use it
items: To run your account, household and pet records, and to carry out the bookings, orders, trips and payments you ask for.
To keep you and the platform safe: sign-in codes, security alerts, fraud prevention, moderation and dispute handling.
To send the notifications you need, and marketing messages only if you agree to them.
To give support and improve the service, using our own records. We don't build advertising profiles.
To meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Health information
items: Your pets' health records are visible only to you, to household members you allow, and to people you choose to share them with.
A share link lasts between 1 hour and 7 days (24 hours by default). It shows only the sections you pick, logs every opening and can be revoked at any time.
You can share records with a vet of a verified clinic for up to 90 days, and revoke this at any time.

When you book a service, the partner sees only what that service needs. Clinical and boarding services can see health information; grooming and walking cannot. This access ends 24 hours after the booking.

When you book a vet visit, you can also tick health documents for that visit. Only the vet assigned to the booking can open them, and only until 24 hours after the visit. Nothing is shared unless you tick it.

sections.heading: 5. Location
items: We use your location only when you allow it in the browser, and only for the feature you are using.

When you save an address, you place its point on the map and agree to us storing it; we record when you agreed. The point stays private to you and your household: we use it to work out delivery costs, fares and what is near you. Sellers, providers and other members don't see it. You can move the point or delete the address at any time.

Partners' business locations are shown publicly on the map at the pinned spot. Partners who work from home, such as sitters, walkers and home stays, are shown only at an approximate point about 1 km from the real one, unless they choose to show the exact spot.
For lost-pet area alerts, your location is rounded to about 1 km and never shown to others. Lost-pet reports show only the area the owner writes.
During a pet-taxi ride, the driver's live position is shared with you. After 30 days, trip locations are kept only roughly, to about 1 km.

sections.heading: 6. Who we share it with
items: Partners: the clinic, provider, seller, host or driver you book or buy from gets what they need to serve you (your name, contact details, address, and the pet information allowed for that service).
Couriers: for delivery, your name, phone number and delivery address.
Payment providers: when you pay online, the payment gateway processes the payment. We receive the result, not your card details.
Messaging: sign-in codes and SMS notifications go through our SMS provider, Faraz. Emails are sent from our own mail server. Push notifications pass through your browser's push service.

Maps: maps on the site load tiles from OpenStreetMap. If we switch on another map provider, such as Google Maps, maps and place searches may load from that provider instead. These services see the area you are viewing or searching, not your account.
Insurers: only when you submit an insurance application, and only after you agree. The insurer then receives your contact details and your pet's species, breed, age and weight.
Other sites: when you open an external listing, for example on Jajiga, we record the click, and that site's own privacy policy applies from then on.
Trust badge: when the e-trust (eNamad) badge is shown at the bottom of our pages, your browser loads it from enamad.ir, which can see your IP address and that you are on opetlife.
Authorities: when the law requires it, for example under a court order.
We never sell your personal data. Our staff can see personal data only as their role needs. Revealing a customer's full contact details requires a special permission, and every reveal is logged.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and local storage
items: petlife_session keeps you signed in. It lasts 30 days, can't be read by page scripts, and is sent only to our site.
petlife_csrf protects your forms and actions against cross-site requests.
petlife_oauth_state is used only during Google sign-in and lasts 10 minutes.
NEXT_LOCALE remembers the language you chose.
Your browser's local storage keeps a few small preferences on your device, such as the dog-cursor setting.

We do not use advertising, analytics or social-media tracking cookies. Our links to Instagram, Telegram and other social networks are plain links: nothing from those services loads until you open one.

sections.heading: 8. Notifications
items: We notify you in the app, and by push, SMS or email depending on your settings.
Marketing messages are off unless you turn them on. Security alerts, such as a new sign-in or a changed password, can't be turned off.
You can set quiet hours (22:00–08:00, Tehran time). Non-urgent SMS is then held until morning, and push notifications arrive silently.

For push notifications we store your device's push address and keys. A push message carries only a short title for its category and a link, never the details, and the device is removed when you sign out.

sections.heading: 9. How long we keep it
items: Account, household and pet data: as long as your account is open.
Sign-in sessions: 30 days, unless you sign out sooner.
Data export files: 7 days.
Pet-taxi trips: exact locations for 30 days, then only roughly.
Server logs: about 7 days.
Financial records, such as orders, payments, refunds and invoices: for as long as the law requires.

If you ask to delete your account, your request is recorded and reviewed, and it is carried out once our data-retention policy is published. We will then delete or anonymise your personal data, except what the law requires us to keep, and tell you when it is done.

sections.heading: 10. Your rights and choices
items: See and correct your data from your profile, household and pet pages.

Download a copy of your data from Profile → Privacy. You get a file with your pets, health records, bookings, orders, trips, support requests, consents, posts, chats and donations. The download stays available for 7 days.
Change notification channels and marketing consent, and revoke share links and vet access, at any time.

Ask to delete your account from Profile → Privacy. Your request is recorded and reviewed, and it is carried out once our data-retention policy is published; we will tell you when it is done. You can cancel while the request is pending. While you have open bookings, orders, refunds, disputes, an active trip or a partner role, deletion has to wait until they are finished.
Raise a privacy concern through Support or the Contact page.

sections.heading: 11. How we protect it
paragraphs: Connections to opetlife are encrypted. Passwords are stored only as Argon2id hashes. Sign-in cookies can't be read by page scripts. Staff access depends on their role and is logged. Uploaded documents are kept privately and can be opened only through short-lived links. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong password and keep your sign-in codes to yourself.

Photos you publish, such as in posts, lost-pet reports or memorials, are public files: removing or hiding them takes them off opetlife pages straight away, but someone who already has a photo's address may still open it until the file itself is deleted. Ask Support and our team will delete the file within 30 days.

sections.heading: 12. Children
paragraphs: Accounts are for people aged 18 and over. Children can take part only through a household managed by a parent or guardian, who is responsible for what is added about them.

sections.heading: 13. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: Changes take effect when we publish them here. For important changes, we also show a notice on the site and email you if your account has an email address. The date at the top shows the latest version.

sections.heading: 14. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions or requests, use Support or the Contact page.
